scope: Audit reusable NPI readiness template versions and independently frozen Project checklist instances against the exact Phase 4 through P7-04 evidence foundations.
Freeze checklist category, owner, due date, status, evidence, applicability, blocking level and exact Gate-or-policy reference semantics without inventing production defaults.
Freeze deterministic server-derived category and total readiness scores while keeping every applicable blocker separately dominant over percentage.
Separate NPI evidence, controlled reports and unavailable formal ERP results, and preserve Gate evaluation as a separately authorized existing policy command.
Define the minimum complete vertical slice, ownership, additive persistence, closed BFF, trilingual industrial workspace, tests, migration and rollback before product code.
non_scope: Product implementation before the P7-05 audit and frozen plan pass.
Automatic G6 or G7 pass/close, Gate policy invention, automatic Work Item closure, Tooling lifecycle mutation or production handover.
Fabricated ERP material, quality, Run-at-rate, OEE, yield, supplier, training or production-result truth; production ERPNext access or mutation.
Hard-coded PFMEA, MSA, CPK, PPAP or automotive applicability for every Project, or caller-supplied readiness scores and blocker suppression.
Released Trial Summary, external event projection, production print, raw private File URLs, generic DocType CRUD, core patches, test deletion or threshold reduction.

expected_state.controller_marker: P7-04 Level 2 PASS; P7-05 audit active

rollback.before_product_resume: Restore the P7-04 Level 2 checkpoint; the bounded P7-05 audit creates no product row, route, metadata or external effect.
rollback.after_product_resume: Use the rollback frozen in the accepted P7-05 plan; after retained readiness history, disable only independent P7-05 routes and workspace and deliver reviewed forward repair without rewriting templates, instances, evidence or derived snapshots.
